notes: GPS immediate map marker and active stop note/symptom access repair.
summary: Shows current-location marker as soon as activity starts, keeps GPS listening on signal timeouts, and makes active stop note/symptom entry easier to reach during a running activity.
label: GpsMapMarkerStopNoteSymptomAccessRepair
whatsNew: Live Route Map now shows the current-location indicator immediately on Start Activity when a readiness fix exists.
Running activities now show a direct Stop Note / Symptom button beside Finish Activity.
GPS watch handling keeps listening during signal/timeouts instead of prematurely stopping the watch.
Version number, date, service worker cache, manifest, FAQ, and help text updated for v9.10.347.139.
fixes: Fixes lack of an immediate map location marker after Start Activity.
Fixes active-stop access by adding a visible Stop Note / Symptom control while timer is running.
Fixes GPS timeout handling so the active watch is not cleared for ordinary signal/searching errors.
